verdict.rationale: Azure publishes its machine-readable REST API specifications in the official Azure/azure-rest-api-specs GitHub repository, described as the canonical source. It holds downloadable per-service Swagger 2.0 documents, versioned by api-version, with newer specs generated from TypeSpec. The probe's 404s at learn.microsoft.com/openapi.json only show the specs are not served from the docs domain, not that they are unavailable. Missing for 10: specs are Swagger 2.0 rather than OpenAPI 3.x, they are split per service with no single unified spec and folder paths move as the layout changes, and there is no independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: This repository is the canonical source for REST API specifications for Microsoft Azure.
publishes downloadable per-service specification documents versioned in stable/ and preview/ folders
